text:
ITEM 1 | Two pieces of light golden-brown meat with a crisp, slightly bumpy browned crust on the outer surface, pale cream-white interior visible at cut edges, a small amount of glossy reddish-orange glaze or seasoning flecks on the top, sitting in the left-center of the plate; pieces roughly 5 to 6 cm long and 3 to 4 cm wide, about 2 to 3 cm thick, with a moist, slightly sheen surface | 180
ITEM 2 | Fluffy, separate white grains with some pale tan flecks mixed in, moist but not sticky, mounded on the right side of the plate covering roughly a quarter of the plate, about 2 to 3 cm tall, with a small green streak (possibly a thin strip of herb or vegetable) lying across it | 150
ITEM 3 | Small bits of finely chopped reddish-orange and green pieces scattered over the meat, with a golden, slightly oily sauce or seasoning coating the meat surface and pooling lightly at the base of the meat pieces | 10
